content: Moiragi waikatakatainama

Raḡan tenaḡa Yesu gabu ḡesaune ya moimoiragina. Be ya moimoiragi kovina murine, na tauwai muriwatanama tenaḡa ya riuna, “Bada, moiragi kwai kataimai da tauma nama sibo kè moiragina, maika Jon na tauwai muriwatanama yai katakataidina nama.”
Yesu ya riuedina, “Raḡanine ko moiragina, umanama ko riu:

content.text: Mamai, dobu matabuna isamma babaunama sibo a vivirena. Tam am waibadama sibo ya verau.
Ama kanima raḡan patapatanama sibo kuya utemai.
“Bada, ama gewagewama kwa noḡota poredi maika tauma ama banagama ḡaromaie gewagewa a voivoiedina ka noḡonoḡota poredina nama.

content: Dabudine Yesu ya riuedina, “Deḡoda tam aitau turamma risine kupi poune ku naḡo be ku riuena, ‘Yau tura, buredi rabuiteḡa kwa utegu,
baninama turaguma yodi vaḡaie ya tava be taugu nam ḡarogue aba da sibo è ute.’
Be turamma vada nopone i paribeem be i riuna, ‘Nam kwa taiḡosoḡosorigu, taugu yau sedama mate matakeda kè gudu be ka kenakenana, tokare nam aiyaba yà utem.’”
Dabudine Yesu ya riuna, “Taugu yà riuriuemina da turamma nam i ḡoena da sibo ya midisuḡu be kani ya utem. Be am waibaḡa dobidobima aubainama tauna tokare e midisuḡu da kani e utemna.
“Vutuna aubainama yà riuriuemina, koi baḡa be e utemina, ko wane be ko banavina, ko raupewapewa be ḡaromie e kaiporena.
Baninama aitau ewai baḡana, tokare e paḡona, be aitau e wanewanena, tokare e banavina, be aitau e rarau pewapewana, tokare ḡarone e kaiporena.
“Nam ai gomana kani
i ḡabeḡabe be tamanama yeku i utena, ibewa.
Be nam ai gomana pou i ḡabeḡabe be tamanama rikarikau i utena, ibewa.

Yodi uma ko noḡoti, avedi da taumi banaga gewegewemima be yaḡoro yaba veredima natunatumima ko uteutedina. Vutuna aubainama Tamemima marae tauna teneteneḡinama da aitauḡa Arua Babau tawai baḡena, tokare e utedina.”
Yesu be penama adi guyauma
Yesu penama ya tavu dobiḡena. Be uma peneminama banaga ya koku be ya miamiana tauna gumgum. Be inam penama tauḡoma ya gosegosena raḡanine, tauḡoma giu yai kare munaḡena, be banaga matabudi a basena.
Dabudine banaga ḡesaudima a riuna, “Yesu tauna Belsebul isane penama e tavutavu dobiḡedina. Be Belsebul tauna penama adi guyauma.”
Be banaga ḡesaudima taudi Yesu raurubunama aubainama awai baḡana da sibo mara matairinama ya voie be taudi sibo a kita be ai kawa riukaue da tauna naumeki Mamaitua ḡaronama.

Be Yesu ya kataie da taudi aba awai nuanoḡonoḡotena, aubainama tauna umanama ya riuedina, “Deḡo dobunama tenaḡa e dariḡa munaḡena, tokare taunaḡa e kawa gewagewa munaḡena. Be deḡo vadanama ei mia ḡinanana, tokare taunaḡa ei yamona munaḡena.

Deḡoda Seitan na banagama mate tai ḡinana munaḡedina, tauna tokare na waiguyauma e kawa gewagewa be nam ei rewapana. Umanama yà riuriuna, baninama taumi ko riuriuna da taugu kabe Belsebul isane penama è tavutavu dobiḡedi.

Be deḡoda taugu Belsebul isane, penama è tavutavu dobiḡedina, naumeki da yodi taumi Parisi ami tauwai muriwatanama taudi aitau isane penama ta tavutavu dobiḡedi? Taumi ami tauwai muriwatanama tawai maḡatarana da taumi ko kaikaiyovuna!
Be deḡoda taugu Mamaitua nimarakurakune
penama yà tavutavu dobiḡedina, inam anikitanama Mamaitua na waiguyauma ḡaromie ya tavana.
Deḡoda banaga wairewapaninama ma madana na gabuma e bodabodamena, naumeki da na purapurama tokare ta kena kauana.

Be deḡoda banaga wairewapana vavasaḡinama e tava be inam baneginama e vunuḡi be na madama na kaba waisumaḡedima e ragaudina, inam raḡanine banaga wairewapana vavasaḡinama taubodama na purapurama e ragaudi be na banagama e soiedina.
“Deḡoda tauna aitau nam taugu mate, tauna inam taugu ewai ḡavieguna. Be mate tauna aitau nam taugu mate kama noyanoya tenaḡana, tauna inam yau noyama e kawakawa gewagewana.
Penama na kaba tava munaḡama

“Be penama banaga e dobidobi porena raḡanine, tauna dobu pokine e naḡo be na kaba siperema gabunama e wanena. Be deḡoda gabu nam e banavi, tauna tokare e riuna, ‘Taugu yà munaḡana yau vadae, deḡo e veraveraue dabudi.’
Raḡanine tauna e tava munaḡa da vada kavakavanama, kawakawa verenama be waiwaisianama e kenakenana e kitana,

inam raḡanine tauna e munaḡa be penama ḡesaudima, matabudi 7 ei dokedina. Be inam penemidima a gewagewa vavasaḡana, nam maika noḡone. Be taudi matabudi inam vadanama nopone ta saḡa be banaga nopone ta miana. Inam raḡanine banaga na yawasanama e gewagewa vavasaḡana, nam maika noḡone.”
Riukaua na wainuaverema
Raḡanine Yesu inam nama ya giugiuna maika, waivi patara nopodie bonanama dosine Yesu ya riuena, “Nuavere tauna aitau tam ya tikam be yai susumna.”
Be Yesu inam waivinama ya paribee be ya riuena, “Naumeki aba kuya riuena, be nuavere dosinama taudi aitauḡa Mamaitua riunama ta vaivaie be ta voivoiena.”
Jona na matairama

Be patara ya moramorabana raḡanine, Yesu ya riuna, “Taumi uma kimtimima kimta gewegewemima. Taumi matairaḡa kitanama ko ḡoeḡoena, be nam tokare mataira ko kita da Jona na matairama taunaḡa tokare ko kitana.
Jona taunaḡa yai matairana Ninive aubaidima, teneḡinama nama Banaga Natunama tokare ei matairana taumi kimtimima aubaimima.

“Etara raḡanine dobu Saba guyaunama waivinama taumi kimtimima mate ko midisuḡu munaḡana raḡanine, tauna tokare e riuna da taumi kimtimima sibo gienae koya naḡona, baninama boni Saba guyaunama tauna dobu damone, be ya tavana, Solomon na nuauyauyama vaienama aubainama, be yodi uma dobudine banaga tenaḡa Solomon ya saḡa porena be tauna na giuma nam komawai beavaiena.

Etara raḡanine Ninive meagainama banegidima taumi kimtimima mate ko midisuḡu munaḡana raḡanine, taudi ta riuna da taumi kimtimima sibo gienae koya naḡona, baninama boni Jona ya rarau guguyana, be Ninive banegidima a vaie be taudi noḡota vitara a paḡona, be yodi uma dobudine banaga tenaḡa Jona ya saḡa porena, be tauna na giuma nam komawai beavaiena.
Tubuḡa na kodamma
“Nam aitau kodam e gabu be e semo, bo tebo dibune e boru. Ibewa, tauna kodam ḡavoe ei midiri da banaga ta saḡasaḡana ta kitana.
Matamma inam tunimma na kodamma. Deḡoda matamma verenama, naumeki da tunimma matabuna yanayananama, be deḡoda matamma e gewagewana, naumeki da tunimma matabuna ei kupikupina.
Be yodi kwa kita kaua da yana ḡarome nam ei kupikupi.
Deḡoda tam tunimma matabuna yanayananama, be nam tunimma aiyabinama ei kupikupi, naumeki da tunimma matabuna e yanana maika kabe kodam neneḡarinama ḡarome i yanayanana.”
Waisumaḡa kaikaiyovudima
Raḡanine Yesu na giuma yawai kovina, Parisi tenaḡa tauna ya kokonena na vadae kani aubaina. Naumeki da Yesu ya saḡa da ya mia be ya kanikanina.
Be Parisi tauna ya basena, baninama Yesu tauna nimanama nam i koḡa be ya kanikanina.
Be Yesu Parisi ya riuena, “Taumi Parisi raḡan matabuna ami raudunema mataira kitekitedima kowai sumaḡedi be kowai muriwatanedina,
be taumi nopomima gewagewa ya moḡavuna. Taumi maika keaka be tebo tauridima ko koḡekoḡedina be nopodie mira yaḡoro ta kenakenana.
Taumi koya bua kauana! Koya kataie bo ibewa da Mamaitua ḡavoe be nopoe raudunedima tauna ya voiedina?
Taumi nopomima ko koḡedi be ami yawasanama ko kawa didimanidina, yodibe yaba matabuna inam e verena.
“Taumi Parisi ko kita kaua! Baninama yaba matabuna koi rawadamdamdi da matabudi 10 be dam tenaḡa Mamaitua ko uteutena, be kani anitai dinidima mate.
Be taumi banaga ḡesaudima ḡarodie nam komawai rabaraba kauana be Mamaitua nuemima nam ima paḡopaḡona. Taumi yaba matabudi sibo koya voiedina!
“Taumi Parisi, ko kita kauana! Baninama sinagog nopone gabu verediḡa ko ḡoeḡoedina, be taumi ko ḡoeḡoena da debae banaga tai kaiwemina banaga dosidima maika.”

Be Yesu uma wainasinama ya riuedina, “Taumi Parisi, gewagewa ḡaromie! Baninama taumi maika kokoaga nam waimatairidi banaga nam ti kataie be debanaḡa ta naḡo yababa be adi yawasanama ta kawakawa gewegewedina.”
Dabudine tarawatu tauwai katakatainama tenaḡa Yesu ya riuena, “Tauwai katakatai, uma yabedima kwa giugiuedina, tauma mate kwa biribiri dobiḡemaina.”

Be Yesu ya paribee be ya riuna, “Taumi tarawatu tauwai katakataidima, taumi mate ko kita kauana! Baninama taumi banaga vita koi kiroḡidi be ta kirokiroḡa rereḡedina, be taumi nam airaḡan koma sagusagu rubudina.
Ko kita kauana! Baninama boni taumi waḡewaḡemima peroveta ai guridina, be taumi kowai aninedina.
Taumi ko noḡonoḡotina da aba waḡewaḡemima a voivoiedina, inam naumeki, baninama taudi peroveta a vunuḡidi be taumi yodi adi kokoagama koi kitedi be kowai nuaverena.
Vutuna aubainama Mamaitua na nuauyauyae ya riuna, ‘Taugu peroveta be apasol yà riuporaḡana be ḡesaudima tai guridina, be ḡesaudima ta raukivigewegewedina.’
“Raḡan pakane da yodi banaga peroveta ai guridina be kosinidima a darorona aubainama, taumi kimtimima tokare kovoḡa ko paḡona.

Peroveta matabudi Eibol ya naḡo da Sakaraias, tauna olta be tempol poudie ai guridina. Inam banegidima awai guridina kadi taiye naumeki da taumi tokare Mamaitua e kovoḡimina, baninama peroveta awai guridina taumi kowai aninedina aubainama.

“Taumi tarawatu tauwai katakataidima, ko kita kauana! Baninama taumi riukaua kiḡinama koya paḡo be ko semosemona, vutuna aubainama taumi nam tokare marae ko naḡo. Be banaga ḡesaudima taudi marae naḡonama ta ḡoeḡoena, be taumi ko gudugududina.”
Dobudine Parisi be tarawatu tauwai katakataidima nuedima yai medi be bonedima bagibagine awai sinasinana,
da Yesu aba giunama gewagewanama sibo ya vato be a vunuḡina.
